definitions.usage: break, bruise, crush, discourage, oppress, struggle together.
definitions.full: H7533. ratsats [ רָצַץ ] verb crush (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic bruise, bray, crush ; Aramaic רְעַ , crush, shatter ); — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular suffix רַצּוֺתָנוּ 1Sam 12:4 ; 1 singular רַצּוֺתִי 12:3 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יָּרוּץ (Ges § 67q ) Isa 42:4 (Babylonian Manuscript יֵרוֺץ , Niph`al, so SS here and Eccl 12:6 a), 3feminine singular תָּרוּץ 12:6 a, 1singular אָרֻץ Psa 18:30 = אָרוּץ 2Sam 22:30 (see below); Participle active feminine plural רֹצְצוֺת Amos 4:1 ; passive רָצוּץ Isa 42:3 +, construct רְצוּץ Hosea 5:11 ; plural רְצוּצִים Isa 58:6 ; — crush: 1 literal, a. passive participle in (הָ)רָצוּץ (הַ)קָּנֶה 2Kin 18:21 = Isa 36:6 ; 42:3 (all metaphor of weak person). b. imperfect intransitive get crushed (read תֵּרוֺץ ?), of bowl Eccl 12:6 a (in metaphor). 2 figurative crush, oppress , accusative of person 1Sam 12:3-4 , Amos 4:1 ; passive participle Deut 28:33 , as substantive the oppressed Isa 58:6 ; מִשְׁמָּט רְצוּץ Hosea 5:11 (We Now רֹצֵץ , i.e. perverting judgment , but dubious); intransitive get crushed (read יֵרוֺץ ?), of servant of ׳י , under figure of wick, Isa 42:4 (+ יִכְהֶה ) he shall not grow dim or be crushed out. Niph`al be crushed, broken: Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive נְרֹץ (Ges § 67t ) Eccl 12:6 b (of wheel at cistern); Imperfect 2masculine singular תֵּרוֺץ Ezek 29:7 (of Pharaoh as reed, compare Qal 1 a ); Job 20:10 read perhaps יֵרֹצּוּ (for יְרַצּוּ , see רצה Pi`el), are crushed (as) poor men, Bu, compare Hoffm SS Gerber. — Isa 42:2 ; Eccl 12:6 a see Qal. Pi`el crush in pieces: 1 literal (in metaphor) Perfect 2masculine singular רִצַּצְתָּ Psa 74:14 with accusative of thing. 2 figurative = grievously oppress , 3 masculine singular רִצַּץ Job 20:19 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular הָעָם מִן וַיְרַצֵּץ 2Chr 16:10 . Po`el Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיְרֹצְצוּ Judg 10:8 , accusative of person (= Pi`el 2 ; || רעץ ; רצץ here perhaps doublet, so GFM Hpt , compare Bu Now). Hiph`il Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתָּ֫רִץ (Kö i. 352 ; Ba ZMG xliii (1889), 181 thinks Qal ) Judg 9:53 she crushed his skull. Hithpo`el reciprocal, Imperfect 3masculine plural בְּקִרְבָּהּ הַבָּנִים וִיִּתְרֹצְצוּ Gen 25:22 (J) the children crushed (thurst, struck) one another within her.
